scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute!
I can't offer any of my
services to you because
you're carrying too much
stuff. Put your extra items in
Kafra Storage and come again~

scripts.speaker: Milk Vendor
scripts.text:
Hey, hey...
If you bring me
1 Empty Bottle and
15 Zeny, I'll exchange
them for 1 Milk. How
does that sound?

scripts.speaker: Milk Vendor
scripts.text:
Hey...
You don't have
any Empty Bottles.
I can't really give you
this milk any other
way, you know...

scripts.speaker: Milk Vendor
scripts.text:
Oh, whoa~!
You don't have enough
zeny to exchange all
these Empty Bottles for
Milk. You need to have
at least {0} zeny.

scripts.speaker: Milk Vendor
scripts.text:
Hmm...
Would you make
a little more room
in your inventory
before I give you
all of this milk?
